title: Make the concurrent-worker git guard count siblings inside a granted worktree
action: Fix resolve_live_worker_count so a granted worktree resolves the workers that actually share its index, reaching the control root's mirrored holds/lease data instead of the worktree's empty store. Deny-more only, a solo worktree session stays unblocked, and unresolvable state keeps failing safe.

truths: With two or more sibling workers live in a granted worktree, the write-guard hook exits 2 for a bare git commit and names how many workers are live.
In the same state a genuinely path-scoped git commit -- <path> still exits 0.
A solo session in its own granted worktree is never blocked from committing.
Every verdict reachable from the main checkout today is unchanged.
Unresolvable reservation state still resolves as more than one worker, never as zero.
New tests cover all four cases above and the existing write_guard suite stays green.

acceptance: With sibling workers live in a granted worktree, the write-guard hook exits 2 for a bare git commit and exits 0 for a path-scoped git commit -- <path>; a solo session in a worktree is never blocked; every main-checkout verdict is unchanged; unresolvable state still counts as more than one worker. New tests cover all four cases.

trace.outcome: The concurrent-worker git guard now counts siblings inside a granted worktree via the control root's mirrored-holds ledger
deviations: The cell files were not pre-reserved on dispatch; reserved both under wk-wgg-2 before the first write.
The dispatch never registered wk-wgg-2 in state.workers[]; registered it via bee state worker add per the cap refusal FIX rather than recording a false inline run.

Reused the write-guard own mirrored-holds reader (find_foreign_holds, hooks/write_guard/store.rs) with an all-holds sentinel instead of verbs/reservations/leases.rs, which is a private module whose export would need verbs/reservations/mod.rs — outside this cell files. Same sentinel trick bee reservations list already uses, so no second reader was written.
Capped with --sync-ack: the workflow-state area owns four skills, none of which change here; the cell declares affects_skills [] and names only the two guard files.
